data.professional_title: BUSINESS ARCHITECT | SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST | BANKING & PAYMENTS TRANSFORMATION
data.summary:
Business Architect / Senior Business Analyst with 16+ years of banking experience across retail banking, wholesale banking, digital banking, payments, reconciliation and transformation initiatives. Experienced in Business Capability Mapping, value-stream definition, Target Operating Model (TOM) design, Customer Journey Mapping, AS-IS / TO-BE process modelling, process re-engineering and optimization. Strong payments exposure spanning EFTS, NEFT, Direct Debit, Bill Payment, individual and bulk payments, Payhub, SWIFT payments and payment reconciliation. Proven ability to work with CXOs, business stakeholders, product teams and technology teams to translate business strategy into process architectures, transformation roadmaps, requirements and implementable solutions.
CORE EXPERTISE
Business Architecture: Business Capability Mapping, Value Stream Definition, Process Architecture, Architecture Blueprints, Transformation Roadmaps, Strategic Impact Assessment
Business Analysis: Requirement Elicitation, BRD / Functional Documentation, User Stories, Workflow Design, Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis, Traceability, UAT
Process Transformation: Target Operating Model (TOM) Design, AS-IS / TO-BE Modelling, Process Re-engineering, Process Optimization, Automation, RPA
Customer & Digital: Customer Journey Mapping, Customer Experience Design, Digital Banking Transformation, Customer Onboarding
Payments & Banking: EFTS, NEFT, Direct Debit, Bill Payments, Individual & Bulk Payments, Payhub, SWIFT Payments, Payment Reconciliation, Retail & Wholesale Banking
Tools / Methods: Abacus Enterprise Architecture, Blueprint, SmartStream TLM 2.7, JIRA, Confluence, Agile / Scrum, TOGAF, Lean Six Sigma
CAREER HIGHLIGHTS
Enterprise Business Architecture for a top-tier Middle Eastern bank covering Business Capability Mapping, value streams, current/future-state process modelling and transformation roadmaps.
Hands-on retail banking payments experience including EFTS, NEFT, Direct Debit, Bill Payment, Payhub, individual and bulk payment setup, and payment reconciliation.
Designed customer experiences and proposed AS-IS / TO-BE processes with estimated benefits across banking transformation initiatives.
Worked with major banking and financial-services clients including Bank Albilad, Bank of Muscat, Scotiabank, Mastercard, Citi, JPMC, Deutsche Bank and State Street.

responsibilities: Designed customer experiences and conducted due diligence to identify improvement opportunities and define AS-IS / TO-BE processes with estimated business benefits.
Performed process re-engineering and optimization across banking journeys, identifying automation opportunities using RPA and third-party applications.
Designed and implemented reconciliation processes for wholesale banking clients, including reconciliation of payment transactions.
Led stakeholder workshops and requirement discussions; created Functional Design Documents containing business requirements, user stories and process flows.
Implemented core payment capabilities including NEFT, Direct Debit and Bill Payment, along with account onboarding, account summary, card rebranding and rewards.
Supported the setup and implementation of individual and bulk payments through Payhub, defining relevant business requirements, process flows and payment-processing requirements.
Created traceability matrices and conducted UAT to validate that delivered solutions met business expectations.
Developed reconciliation processes for mutual fund portfolios across multiple asset classes.
Supported process automation and compliance documentation.
Supported Deutsche Bank Frankfurt Nostro account payment investigation activities.
